thread:
Taylor R.: Quick heads-up — final cutover for v2.4 is tomorrow 10:00am PST. Need CI green + version bump + changelog in main. Post quick status here by EOD.
Alex K.: CI is mostly green rn. One flaky test in `integration/streaming_timeout_test` failing intermittently. All unit tests passed.
ci-bot: [build #7821] ✅ passed (main) — duration 12m.
Priya S.: @Alex can you paste the failing log? I can take the flaky if it’s quick.
Alex K.: here’s the failure snippet: ```
FAIL: streaming_timeout_test
AssertionError: expected stream to resume after reconnect
Stack: runtime/streamer.go:312
```
Alex K.: repro locally with `./tools/run_integration --filter streaming_timeout_test --repeat 20` fails ~1/6 runs.
Priya S.: I’ll run that loop now and try a bisect. If it’s network timing we can add tighter retry/assert or a shorter sleep.
Javier M.: FYI we still need the version bump in `pkg/version/version.go` — PR #4592 is pending with changelog.md entry. Can we get that merged before cutoff? https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4592
Taylor R.: @Javier thanks — can you rebase and remove the debug logs? Also we need a short changelog blurb not the draft paragraph. Keep it 1-2 lines.
Javier M.: On it. Will squash + rebase now.
Priya S.: Update: reproduced flaky locally 3/20. Seems tied to connection reset during checkpoint save. Trying a small tweak to backoff and will open a tiny PR if it stabilizes.
Alex K.: nice, thanks. If Priya’s fix lands we should re-run full integration suite.
ci-bot: [build #7822] ❗ flaky detected in integration suite (streaming_timeout_test).
Taylor R.: Decision: wait for Priya's fix. If the fix lands before 21:00 PST we’ll rerun green-sweep overnight. If not, we’ll pin a compatible model variant and proceed with the bump but hold the rollout to Dedicated until Monday.
Alex K.: noted. I’ll also run a quick smoke across mac/linux to catch any platform flakies.
Javier M.: PR #4592 updated and rebased, changelog condensed, removed debug. pinging @Taylor for quick approve.
Taylor R.: approving now. :thumbsup: Javier — please merge after CI passes.
Priya S.: opened PR #4593 with the flaky fix (small retry/backoff). Adds a deterministic sleep and guard for connection reset.
Alex K.: running full integration now against PR #4593.
ci-bot: [build #7827] ✅ integration (PR#4593) — passed.
Alex K.: integration green on Priya’s PR.
Taylor R.: Excellent. Javier merged #4592. Alex please trigger one more green-sweep on main and then we can tag v2.4.0.
Alex K.: triggering: `gh workflow run ci-green-sweep --ref main`
ci-bot: scheduled workflow run 7830.
Taylor R.: Thanks all. Post any last-minute blockers here. If no objections by 21:30 PST I’ll create the v2.4.0 tag and kick the deploy. :rocket:
